The Hawks, led by third-year head coach [[Billy Lange]], played their home games at [[Hagan Arena]] in [[Philadelphia|Philadelphia, Pennsylvania]] as members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. ==Previous season== In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball team|Hawks]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 5–15 overall, 3–9 in A-10 play to finish in 13th place. As the No. 13 seed in the [[2021 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]], they defeated [[2020–21 La Salle Explorers men's basketball team|La Salle]] in the first round before losing to [[2020–21 UMass Minutemen basketball team|UMass]] in the second round. == Offseason == === Departures === {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
